items.title: Who may charge you
items.text: A chasseur immobilier needs a carte professionnelle; agent fees to tenants are capped by law. We open with a licensed partner.

items.title: The rent cap
items.text: The lease must state the reference rent and cannot exceed the increased reference without a justified complément. We run the check.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: One month's rent unfurnished, two furnished, by law. Agents still ask for more, or months in advance. We don't let them.

items.title: Lease type
items.text: Unfurnished, furnished or bail mobilité: each sets notice, deposit and rights. We check which you're handed, and which charges are yours.

papers.summary: The papers a French landlord asks for
papers.tail: The rest our first reply goes through.

items.q: Why isn't BOOM taking searches in Paris yet?
items.a: Searching on a client's behalf is regulated in France: a chasseur immobilier needs a carte professionnelle (loi Hoguet). We open with a licensed partner rather than work around the rule. Your file waits, ready.

items.q: What can you do for me today?
items.a: Open your file, answer your questions the same working day, and tell you honestly what your budget buys in Paris. The prices on this page are set; nothing is charged until the desk opens and the work starts.

items.q: What does an agent legally charge a tenant in France?
items.a: The fees a letting agent may charge a tenant are capped by law, per square metre. An agent you hire, who works only for you, is a different, licensed service. That is why we open with a licensed partner, and never take landlord money.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Paris, the tenant-side desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., a registered Italian agency, opening with a licensed partner (carte professionnelle). Hired and paid by the tenant only.
Internationals relocating to Paris — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
VAT included. No percentage of the rent, nothing from landlords or platforms.

Today: your file, opened and kept ready. When the desk opens: French-format dossier within one working day of your papers, applications as listings appear, attended viewings, rent cap and lease checked, proof of address from day one.
We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't promise a date, and we don't search on your behalf in France before the desk opens.

footer.statement: Launching with a licensed partner. BOOM Paris acts solely as a tenant-side desk: we do not list properties, represent landlords, or receive remuneration from landlords or their agents, and we do not search on a client's behalf in France before the desk opens with its licensed partner.
